answer: Sybil resistance here rests on one concrete gate: every agent identity must post a bond that scales with the trust it claims, and that bond is slashed when the account contradicts itself. A task gets an oasis of allowance only while its history forms one continuous thread of signed, paid work. Forging a thousand sock puppets multiplies the deposit, not the reward, so an ember of spam burns the attacker's own stake before peers ever notice.
